feature_selection.duplicate_ensembl_policy: exclude all non-unique source Ensembl IDs
feature_selection.ensembl_species_policy: retain human ENSG features only for the human K562 target
feature_selection.score: robust z-score of logCP10k variance/mean within deterministic equal-frequency train-mean bins

limitations: The panel is a benchmark measurement target, not a universal cellular state.
TRAIN-only variability selection cannot validate pre-treatment state sufficiency.
The derived logCP10k scale is an assay summary, not latent molecular abundance.

transformation.input: raw integer UMI count vector for one source record
transformation.library_size: sum of all source-axis UMI counts for that record
